title: lepisorus maculosus
intro: Lepisorus maculosus, commonly known as the spotted lepidosorus fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. Lepisorus maculosus is reported to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing oxidative stress, alleviating pain, and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Lepisorus maculosus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
